# Global Construction Management (GCMC)

> GCMC is a general contracting and construction management firm based in Georgetown, Guyana, with over a decade of experience on projects across the Caribbean.

- Phone: +592 609 7398
- Email: jleegcmc@gmail.com
- Location: Georgetown, Guyana

## Services
- [General Construction](https://gcmcgeo.com/services#general-construction): Small to medium commercial projects, from office and restaurant refurbishments to complete small industrial units.
- [Construction Management](https://gcmcgeo.com/services#construction-management): The expertise of a large firm with a boutique, top-down approach, and one team from principals to labourers on site.
- [Building Renovation](https://gcmcgeo.com/services#building-renovation): Renovations that breathe new life into tired buildings, including listed and heritage properties.
- [Property Development](https://gcmcgeo.com/services#property-development): We are actively seeking properties and land with development potential across the Caribbean.
- [AC Service & Maintenance](https://gcmcgeo.com/services#ac-service): Annual maintenance plans that help your air conditioning last longer, with priority service for members.
- [Pool Service](https://gcmcgeo.com/services#pool-service): Skilled pool technicians, the latest treatment solutions and a maintenance schedule built around you.

## Projects
- [Cinema & entertainment fit-out](https://gcmcgeo.com/projects/cinema-fit-out): A large commercial interior taken from open steel shell to finished cinema: lobby, concession stands, auditoriums and the plant rooms behind them.
- [Residential renovations](https://gcmcgeo.com/projects/residential-renovations): Kitchens, bathrooms and living spaces renovated to update the layout, the look and the way a home works.
